title: Crew-13 Dragon 'Grace' launches to ISS on 8-hour transit
detail: Falcon 9 B1101 (third flight) launched Crew-13 from SLC-40 at 15:10 UTC with Jessica Watkins, Luke Delaney, Joshua Kutryk (CSA) and Sergey Teteryatnikov (Roscosmos) for a six-month Expedition 75 stay, targeting the fastest Dragon transit to date. Landing planned at LZ-40, which would be the 664th Falcon booster landing. SpaceX reportedly scheduled three missions within 13 hours, including Transporter-18 and an NRO Falcon Heavy.
